caseName: Patterson v. Superior Court of California
caseNameFull: Patterson v. Superior Court of California in and for the County of Fresno

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Cal. Application for stay, presented to Mr. Justice Douglas, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Stay heretofore granted by Mr. Justice Douglas on March 21, 1975, post, p. 1301, is vacated.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents from Court’s order vacating his previous stay.
